name: stream
title: Stream: New, Library, Margins
summary: The Following tab becomes New: one chronological stream of everything that arrived (new episodes folded to one row per show, items you added, shared Margins you received). Shows get their own screen, reached from a show's name in New or from the Library's Shows sort. Manage feeds goes away: following, browsing and importing a list all live in the Add sheet. Settings has a gear on every tab and is tidied into six sections.
shared_fixes: Margins list newest first; a Margin row plays its moment and a chevron opens its details.
Margin details offer Share this Margin (a one-Margin packet to the share sheet).
Item details show the published date and the date added.
Export all Margins is one toolbar button on the Margins tab that hands a Markdown bundle to the share sheet; the folder export moves under Settings.
Settings is one tap from every tab (gear). The Library's options menu is removed; Help lives in Settings.
Clear reproducible audio is a button on Settings itself; Offline Storage keeps the detail.
Unfollow lives on the Show screen with an Undo toast instead of a confirmation alert; no landing tab manages a feed.
Settings sections: Voice, Storage, Notes folder, Import & export (collapsed to two rows), Help, About & legal (collapsed).

screens.title: New
screens.note: A chronological stream. New episodes are folded to one row per show per day ('The Daily · 3 new'), which expands in place. Tapping the show's name opens the Show screen, where Quiet and Unfollow live; nothing on this tab manages a feed. Items you added and shared Margins you received appear in the same stream.
